message: The astro target does not support interactivity: Astro components render on the server only, and each render is a new instance: event handlers, template refs, watchers and lifecycle hooks never run, and state keeps its initial value.
SaveButton declares no event `svae`: a component passes no DOM listener through to its root, and `onSvae` listens to an event the component emits. Did you mean `onSave`?
help: Listen to an event SaveButton declares with `defineEmits`, or listen on an element inside it.
